record_title: Critical recurrence rigidity and exact stability closure for periodic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky flows
provenance: An exact critical-energy kernel classification for periodic conservative-flux Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations, with recurrence and invariant-measure consequences and a classical-KS stability-boundary corollary.
limitations: The general-flux recurrence theorem assumes sufficient regularity; general-flux global attraction additionally requires established global well-posedness and precompactness. The unconditional global-attraction statement is restricted to the classical one-dimensional periodic KS equation. Several older full texts remain residual originality risks for the classical critical special case; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
